personalities.name: Brawler
personalities.label: fights at contact, hunts atari, takes stones, plays into tight spots

personalities.name: Skydiver
personalities.label: plays the centre, stays off the edge, opens toward the centre, finishes early

personalities.name: Landgrabber
personalities.label: stays low, opens low, hugs the edge, opens on the edge

personalities.name: Architect
personalities.label: keeps its stones breathing, rarely ataris, avoids contact, leaves stones alone

personalities.name: Grinder
personalities.label: throws stones in, plays long games, ignores the last move, avoids contact
